## Engineer judge verdict, PR #503 (#477, M4-02), round 1: **sound**

**Work ruled on:** head `2241b82e646247db82dae465dd0d2fbcb7e098e0`, base `origin/main` at `ef60b49` (also the merge base).
**Acceptance revision:** #477's body as amended under ruling 6, last edited 2026-10-01T14:56:47Z (announced in issue comment 5934050173).
**Angle:** the `SHAPES` change and its tests, the config files, mutations, and whether the deltas can be built by #356, #480, #481, #483 and #488. I ruled on every item.

Evidence comes from a fresh clone of `https://github.com/williacj/rigger.git` with `TMPDIR` set to my scratchpad, outside every checkout, at `pr503` = `2241b82`.

### Acceptance, item by item

| # | Item | Ruling | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Where provider assets live and Provider adapters rows as Delta 1 | met | Ruling 1's Delta 1 quotes were compared whitespace-normalised against the head's `ARCHITECTURE.md`. Both rows appear verbatim. |
| 2 | Delta 1's adapter paragraph below the table | met | Verbatim, directly after the worktree paragraph. |
| 3 | Roles row as Delta 2 | met | Verbatim. |
| 4 | Engineer line as ruling 6 corrects it | met | The exact line, with its leading spaces and trailing comma, appears byte for byte in the published block (`ARCHITECTURE.md:155`). |
| 5 | Delta 2's role paragraph, 14,400,000 ms, four hours | met | The paragraph reads as Delta 2 with `<OQ5>` filled as "14,400,000 milliseconds, which is four hours", and with the ruling-internal "(Q3)" dropped. |
| 6 | Names `standard` and `high`; adapter maps each to a model | met | That paragraph's first sentence. |
| 7 | Census paragraph directly after "…outside this containment.", with N3 wording | met | `this containment.\n\nA dispatch runs in a directory` is present. The paragraph matches Delta 3, with "is that directory or lies under it" in place of "lies under that directory". |
| 8 | The next paragraph opens "Where a process that left its group holds…", otherwise as base | met | Against the base, its only changes are that phrase and item 14's slot sentence, which another item names. Line wrapping is kept. |
| 9 | Judge directory's `main` and `head` paragraph | met | Verbatim. |
| 10 | Engine settings Read by cell as Delta 4, split into sentences | met | Delta 4 with every `;` turned into `. ` appears verbatim, ending "L3 for N. L5 for the push". |
| 11 | Delta 5 after "L2 gives L3 next actions." | met | Verbatim. Only the rest of that line is rewrapped, and its words are unchanged. |
| 12 | Delta 6 after the workspace sentence | met | Verbatim. |
| 13 | Four-step order and "A card L3 pulls from Review starts at step 4." | met | Verbatim. |
| 14 | New slot sentence; old one gone | met | The new sentence is present. "L3 frees the dispatch's slot" occurs 0 times at the head. |
| 15 | `R-STATE-6` cited nowhere | met | It occurs 0 times at the head and 0 at the base. |
| 16 | `SHAPES.role` holds `labels` and `timeout`, neither required | met | `labels: {}` and `timeout: {}` at `src/config/validate.mjs:89-90`, with no `required`. A probe shows `validate()` accepts the live config with an engineer declaring `labels: { 'tier:high': 'high' }, timeout: 14400000` and returns `[]`. The same probe still refuses a misspelt `timeoutt`. |
| 17 | `validate.mjs` changes only inside `SHAPES` | met | `git diff -U0 origin/main -- src/config/validate.mjs` shows one hunk, `@@ -85,0 +86,5 @@`, inside `SHAPES.role`. |
| 18 | `rigger.config.mjs` and `templates/rigger.config.mjs` byte-identical to base | met | `git diff --quiet origin/main -- rigger.config.mjs templates/rigger.config.mjs` exits 0. Nothing under `.githooks/`, nor `src/cli/rigger.mjs` or `package.json`, changes either. |
| 19 | No `ARCHITECTURE.md` change beyond the acceptance | met | Every hunk in `git diff origin/main -- ARCHITECTURE.md` maps to items 1–14. |
| 20 | Both-directions test passes at head | met | `npm test -- test/config.test.mjs` reports 71 pass and 0 fail. The test discriminates; see the mutations below. |
| 21 | `lint:spec-style` adds nothing; the PR gives base and head counts | met | I measured 0 findings at the base `ef60b49` and 0 at the head. The PR body gives 0 and 0. |
| 22 | `npm test`, `check:references`, `check:paths` exit 0 at head | met, on CI | `check:references` and `check:paths` each exit 0 in my clone. Full `npm test` exits 0, with 1606 tests, 1606 pass and 0 fail. That figure is **not counted**: the one-minute load on 12 CPUs was 39.11 before the run and 49.64 after it. CI at `2241b82` is the figure of record: `check (20)` and `check (24)` pass in both runs, 36880810630 and 36880823147, and `demo` passes too. |
| 23 | PR says it is a proposal and names ruling 1 and ruling 5 on #332 per delta | met | The body's first paragraph and its "Source of each delta" table. |

### Mutations on the shape test

Each mutation was applied in place in the clone. I confirmed it with `git diff -U0`, ran `npm test -- test/config.test.mjs`, and restored the file with `git checkout -- .`, which left a clean tree.

| Mutation (diff confirmed) | Result |
|---|---|
| Drop `timeout: {},` from `SHAPES.role` | exit 1, 70 pass and 1 fail. The failing test is "what the validator offers is exactly what ARCHITECTURE.md publishes, in both directions", on `- 'roles.*.timeout'`: published but not offered. |
| Drop `, timeout: 14400000` from the published engineer line | exit 1. The same test fails on `+ 'roles.*.timeout'`: offered but not published. |
| Drop `labels: {},` from `SHAPES.role` | exit 1. The same test fails on `- 'roles.*.labels'`. |
| Drop `labels: { 'tier:high': 'high' }, ` from the published line | exit 1. The same test fails on `+ 'roles.*.labels'`. |

Removing either key from either side reds the named test, on the assertion about that key. The test holds in both directions for both keys.

### Whether the cards that rely on these deltas can build against them

- **#356 (census):** they are consistent. Its items match "is that directory or lies under it": a prefix-named sibling is left alive, and a command that is not a dispatch keeps its group as its whole containment. So do the record entry carrying the directory, a later start doing the same, and the refusal of a second dispatch on a held directory.
- **#480 (Claude Code adapter):** they are consistent. `name`, `auth`, `assets`, `tiers` and `invocation` map onto the adapter paragraph's doctor, init, tier-to-model and command-line-plus-stdin facts. The ".mcp.json only" and "no widening flag" items match the Provider adapters row and the paragraph's last sentence.
- **#481 (`roleDispatch`):** they are consistent. The timeout comes from the role answer, as Delta 2's role `timeout` declares. The digest in `dispatch.start` is Delta 6.
- **#483 (judge directory):** they are consistent. `<root>/judges/<topic>/<role>` matches. So do `main` and `head` at detached commits, with `main` taken from the forge when the directory is made.
- **#488 (judges):** they are consistent. Step 4, "starts at step 4", the shared claim and slot, and steps in `head` before the judge all appear.
- **#482 (M4-04)** keeps the value checks: the tier set, the `labels` values, a positive whole `timeout`, a role name without `/`, and the 14,400,000 helper. At this head a role `timeout` of `-5` is therefore accepted. That is by design and not this card's.

### Coverage of the card (`R-LOOP-6`)

The acceptance covers what the card asked: ruling 1's seven deltas, as ruling 6 corrects them, and `SHAPES` gaining both keys with the published shape, under P1 on #423. Nothing needs returning to the author.

### Blocking findings

None.

### Non-blocking observations (2)

1. Delta 3, from ruling 1 verbatim and not the maker's doing, says "A card's maker and its provisioning steps run one at a time in the card's workspace". Step 4 also runs a card's steps in each judge's `head`, and the architecture names no census directory for such a step. Ruling 1 Q3 says only "For a step it stays the card's workspace". #488's maker will have to choose: the judge directory, or `head`. The census paragraph's first sentence still holds either way. This is for the architect, not this PR.
2. The Provider adapters row says the adapter builds the invocation "in one directory", and nothing in `ARCHITECTURE.md` names the `reach` directory that #480, #481 and #488 hand the adapter. That is consistent, because `reach` loads nothing. Still, the architecture is silent on a parameter three cards build against. This is also ruling 1's text, carried faithfully.

### Verification run

- Fresh clone at `2241b82`: `npm ci`, then `npm test -- test/config.test.mjs` gave 71 pass and 0 fail.
- Four mutations as tabled above. Each turned the named test red and was restored.
- `npm run lint:spec-style` gave 0 findings at the head and 0 at the base `ef60b49`.
- `npm run check:references` exited 0, and so did `npm run check:paths`.
- `npm run budget:package` exited 0, with 3210 production lines against a budget of 12000. `npm run matrix:check` exited 0.
- Full `npm test` exited 0, with 1606 of 1606 passing. It is not counted, at load 39.11 to 49.64 on 12 CPUs, so CI is the figure of record and is green.
- `gh pr checks 503`: every check passes.
- One throwaway probe of `validate()` ran under plain `node --test`, against the pure validator only, not through `npm test`. It stands only as supporting evidence for item 16. That item already rests on the shape test and the diff.

**Verdict: sound** at `2241b82`, against #477's acceptance as amended at 2026-10-01T14:56:47Z.

## Reviewer verdict — #477 (M4-02), PR #503, round 1: **sound**

**Work ruled on:** head `2241b82e646247db82dae465dd0d2fbcb7e098e0`, base `ef60b49` (`origin/main` at review time, and the merge base).
**Acceptance revision:** #477's body as last edited 2026-10-01T14:56:47Z (the PM's amendment under ruling 6, announced in issuecomment-5934050173). It has 23 items.

I checked each delta's text against these sources on #467: ruling 1 Deltas 1–7, ruling 3 P8, ruling 5 and ruling 6. I also checked the census against #332's ruling 5 §3 (issuecomment-5861497456). I compared word by word, and compared the engineer line byte for byte with a script.

### Acceptance, item by item

| # | Item | Ruling | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Delta 1's two Extension-point rows | met | Both rows in `git diff ef60b49 -- ARCHITECTURE.md` match ruling 1's Delta 1 word for word. That includes "from the directory the dispatch runs in" and "Claude Code shipped; Codex shipped in M4". |
| 2 | Delta 1's adapter paragraph below the table | met | It sits after the worktree paragraph, where Delta 1 places it, and its five sentences match the ruling verbatim. |
| 3 | Roles row as Delta 2 | met | Both cells are verbatim. |
| 4 | Engineer line as ruling 6 corrects it | met | A Python byte comparison found the acceptance's line, and ruling 6's code-block line, in `ARCHITECTURE.md`'s lines (`True`, `True`). |
| 5 | Delta 2's paragraph, with 14,400,000 ms, four hours | met | The text is present. `<OQ5>` is filled as "14,400,000 milliseconds, which is four hours". The ruling's "(Q3)" was dropped, which is disclosed (see N1). |
| 6 | Names `standard` and `high`, and says the adapter maps each to a model | met | It is the paragraph's first sentence. |
| 7 | Census paragraph directly after "…outside this containment.", reading "is that directory or lies under it" | met | The base sentence now ends at that point, and the census paragraph follows as the next paragraph. It is ruling 1's Delta 3 text verbatim with ruling 6's N3 change. Its sentences 1 and 4–7 match #332 ruling 5 §3. |
| 8 | Following paragraph opens "Where a process that left its group holds…" and is otherwise byte-identical | met | `git diff` shows that phrase and one other change, the slot sentence at the paragraph's end. Item 14 requires that sentence's replacement, and item 19 admits changes "this acceptance names". Line wrapping is otherwise unchanged. See N2 on the wording. |
| 9 | Judge-directory paragraph (`main`, `head`) | met | Delta 3's OQ1 (B) text is verbatim. It is consistent with ruling 3 P8: the agent CLI runs in `main`, and steps run in `head`. |
| 10 | Engine settings Read-by cell as Delta 4, with semicolons as full stops | met | The cell holds five sentences. Every word of Delta 4 is kept, in order, and every semicolon is now a full stop, including "L3 for N. L5 for the push". |
| 11 | Delta 5 directly after "L2 gives L3 next actions." | met | Both sentences are verbatim. |
| 12 | Delta 6 directly after the workspace sentence in Telemetry | met | The sentence is verbatim. |
| 13 | Delta 7's four-step order, with "A card L3 pulls from Review starts at step 4." | met | Step 4 and the sentence are verbatim. Steps 1–3 and the lead-in are unchanged. |
| 14 | Delta 7's slot sentence, with the old one gone | met | The new sentence is verbatim. `grep -n "frees the dispatch's slot" ARCHITECTURE.md` finds nothing. |
| 15 | No `R-STATE-6` in `ARCHITECTURE.md` | met | `grep -c R-STATE-6 ARCHITECTURE.md` returns 0. |
| 16 | `SHAPES.role` holds `labels` and `timeout`, neither required | met | `src/config/validate.mjs:89-90` holds `labels: {}` and `timeout: {}`. |
| 17 | `validate.mjs` changes nothing outside `SHAPES` | met | `git diff ef60b49 -U0 -- src/config/validate.mjs` has one hunk, `@@ -85,0 +86,5 @@`, inside `SHAPES.role`. |
| 18 | Both config files byte-identical to the base | met | `git diff --quiet ef60b49 -- rigger.config.mjs templates/rigger.config.mjs` exits 0. |
| 19 | Both-directions test passes at the head | met | It passes in my full run and in CI, and it discriminates in both directions (see Verification). |
| 20 | No `ARCHITECTURE.md` change beyond what the acceptance names | met | Every hunk maps to items 1–14. The only other edits are the line breaks the insertions force: the boundary rule 2 rewrap, and the paragraph split after "this containment." |
| 21 | `lint:spec-style` adds no finding, and the PR gives counts at base and head | met | My run found 0 findings at `ef60b49` and 0 at `2241b82`, and the PR states the same. |
| 22 | `npm test`, `check:references` and `check:paths` exit 0 at the head | met | `check:references` and `check:paths` both exit 0 in my run. I do not count my suite figure, because the load was above 12. CI is green at `2241b82` (see Verification). |
| 23 | PR body says it is a proposal and names ruling 1 and #332 ruling 5 as each delta's source | met | The body opens "**This is a proposal**". Its "Source of each delta" table names ruling 1 for Deltas 1, 2 and 4–7, and #332 ruling 5 §3 together with ruling 1 for the census. |

### Did the acceptance cover what the card asked (`R-LOOP-6`)

Yes. Every part of ruling 1 Deltas 1–7 has an item. So do ruling 6's four corrections, the `R-STATE-6` removal and #423's P1 pairing of `SHAPES` with the published shape. Nothing the card asks for is missing.

### Blocking findings

None.

### Spec-style rules 2 and 4, by hand

- **Rule 2.** No inserted sentence or table cell passes 40 words, and the lint agrees with 0 findings. Delta 4 as one sentence would have been 49 words, and ruling 6's split resolves it.
- **Rule 4.** I read every inserted sentence and row. Two sentences come closest to three conditions, and I rule that neither breaks the rule:
  - **The census sentence** has one trigger, "After L0 kills a dispatch's group", and two filters, the user and the working directory. "Is that directory or lies under it" defines one term, so it is one condition (the owner's 2026-09-25 ruling).
  - **The antecedent sentence** conditions on two things: the output held open and the group empty. "A process that left its group" names the holder, and the holder could not be anything else once the group is empty, so it adds no condition. The base sentence already carried the same conditions through "one".
- **The Roles cell and the adapter paragraph** enumerate what is declared or held, and state no conditions.

### Non-blocking (3)

- **N1.** Delta 2's paragraph drops the ruling's "(Q3)". It points into ruling 1 on #467 rather than into `ARCHITECTURE.md`, so keeping it would leave a cross-reference the document cannot resolve. The PR discloses the drop. I judge it faithful, and the owner may confirm.
- **N2 (for the acceptance's author).** Item 8 says "otherwise byte-identical to the base". Yet the paragraph it names ends in the slot sentence that item 14 replaces. Read alone, item 8 conflicts with item 14, so I read it with item 19. A future revision could name the exception.
- **N3.** `labels` and `timeout` are now accepted with no type check. A config declaring `timeout: 'abc'` validates and nothing reads it yet. The card limits itself to `SHAPES`, and ruling 6 §1 leaves the refusal of a non-positive `timeout` with #482 (M4-04). This is a sequencing note, not a defect here.

### Verification

All runs used a fresh clone of `https://github.com/williacj/rigger.git` in the scratchpad, checked out at `2241b82` after `npm ci`, which exited 0. The host has 12 CPUs (`sysctl -n hw.ncpu`).

| Command | Ref | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `npm test` | `2241b82` | Exit 0, with 1606 tests, 1606 pass and 0 fail. This includes "what the validator offers is exactly what ARCHITECTURE.md publishes, in both directions". **Not counted:** the one-minute load was 16.09 at the start and 62.47 at the end, which is above 12. |
| CI checks | `2241b82` | Every check run succeeded: check (20) ×2, check (24) ×2 and demo ×2, per `gh api …/commits/2241b82…/check-runs`. `ci.yml` runs `npm test`, `check:references`, `check:paths` and `lint:spec-style`. This is the figure of record. |
| `npm run lint:spec-style` | `2241b82` | Exit 0 with 0 findings. |
| `npm run lint:spec-style` | `ef60b49` | 0 findings. |
| `check:references`, `check:paths`, `check:ids`, `check:words`, `check:headers` | `2241b82` | Each exits 0 with 0 findings. |
| `matrix:check`, `budget:package`, `budget:instructions` | `2241b82` | Each exits 0. The package is at 3210 of 12000 lines, and instructions at 13997 of 14000 words. |

I ran three mutations, each on the working tree only, with nothing committed. After each I restored the file and confirmed with `git status --short`:

- **M1: remove `, timeout: 14400000` from the published engineer line.** The diff confirmed one line changed. `npm test -- test/config.test.mjs` gave 70 pass and 1 fail. The failing test was "…in both directions", on `+   'roles.*.timeout'`.
- **M2: remove `timeout: {},` from `SHAPES.role` alone.** A Python replace asserted a single match on the role block. The diff confirmed one line deleted. The same command gave 70 pass and 1 fail, in the same test, on `-   'roles.*.timeout'`.
- **A discarded first attempt at M2.** My first `sed` also deleted the step's `timeout: {}`, which gave 4 failures. I discarded it and do not count it.

### Verdict

**Sound.** All 23 items are met at `2241b82` against the acceptance as amended at 2026-10-01T14:56:47Z. The owner merges.
